messages.plaintextBody:
Marcus,

Round 2 enquiries below following our review of the data room:

1. Please confirm status of the HMRC R&D enquiry for FY23 and provide latest correspondence.
2. Copy of the Halcyon change-of-control consent once countersigned.
3. Confirmation of the BRCGS renewal audit date.
4. HP/RoT schedule for the production-line equipment (for the Net Debt definition).

These feed the disclosure letter and completion accounts. Grateful for replies by 8 October.

Elena
